column1: # Hand-written translation facts, merged over the generated rows of shader_facts.tsv by dm/gfx/tools/shader_split.py: key <TAB> facts JSON (same format)
# This game has no PC version, so the translator has no fragment output types and declares every output float; Metal refuses a pipeline whose float output meets an integer attachment
# (the host's red line then prints the row to add here). Both rows were found by the PR #11 port (digitalhivehub).
# 0544282c162305db (agl_common BAHS@0x6f840, pixel): the BC4 block encoder. It writes 8-byte blocks through an RGBA16UI view into a 32x32x32 BC4 3D texture (nvn_mtl.m bcrt_attach)
# e3fb0bb58a691e10 (material bfsha BNSH@0xd64000 variation 28, pixel): the Ultrahand mask, an R8Uint target; without it the mask draws were dropped
